situations.headline: Bannerman clears final hurdle for CNOL strategic financing of Etango JV

changelog.entry: stage-2 assessment: Bannerman clears final hurdle for CNOL strategic financing of Etango JV (interest 7, risk 5)

thesis.text: Bannerman is a pre-FID uranium developer whose flagship Etango project in Namibia has now secured a strategic financing and JV partnership with CNNC Overseas Limited, with all conditions precedent satisfied and completion imminent (end Sept 2026) [asx:1fae0286329fcfeb5fa9495c556877e3 p.1]. This materially de-risks funding for a DFS-confirmed, fully permitted project with expansion optionality to 6.7 Mlbs U3O8 [asx:1fae0286329fcfeb5fa9495c556877e3 p.2], positioning the company for a positive FID decision; next catalysts to watch are SSA/SHA completion and subsequent FID timeline.
